doctor.name: Dr. Eric Liberman
doctor.title: Interventional Radiologist
doctor.description: Dr. Eric Liberman is board-certified in Obstetrics and Gynecology and fellowship-trained in Minimally Invasive Gynecologic Surgery (MIGS). He obtained a Focused Practice Designation in MIGS and is the Director of Minimally Invasive Gynecologic Surgery at Holy Name.
